name: open-packets
description: A self-study companion for the Cisco CCNA 200-301 exam (v1.1 and v2.0 tracks): lessons, labs, practice questions, flashcards and trainers. Static site, progress stays in your browser.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-content.mjs && node scripts/check-figures.mjs && node --test scripts/tests/command-content.test.mjs
scripts.test: node --test scripts/test-course-assets.mjs scripts/test-rendering.mjs scripts/test-router.mjs scripts/tests/learning-state.test.mjs scripts/tests/subnet.test.mjs scripts/tests/subnet-ui.test.mjs scripts/tests/commands.test.mjs scripts/tests/command-content.test.mjs scripts/tests/command-ui.test.mjs
scripts.perf:profile: npm run build && node scripts/serve-profile.mjs dist 5173
